children: Trading is halted on New Fortress Energy
after the company said Friday it
that lowers its debt to $700M from $5.7B.
As a result of the completion, New Fortress'
Brazilian business and operations have been separated to establish two distinct, standalone enterprises: BrazilCo and "New NFE."

The company said ​the transaction extinguished ~$5.7B of third-party debt with creditors receiving all the equity of BrazilCo, preferred equity of New NFE with $2.45B of liquidation preference, 65% of the common equity of New NFE, and $571.3M of New NFE term loans; New ​NFE also raised $136.5M in new financing.
"The UK RP restructuring results in the New NFE being a much simpler, more streamlined company," New Fortress

CEO Wes Edens said. "The company owns a portfolio of critical LNG and power assets, including a substantial and growing LNG portfolio, terminal operations and logistics in Mexico and Puerto Rico and a 735 MW power and turbine portfolio. These assets and operations produce significant cash flow today and when fully deployed in the coming months provide the opportunity for significant growth."
